SELECT
    s.id,
    s.user_id,
    a.frozen
FROM sessions AS s
INNER JOIN accounts AS a
    ON a.id = s.user_id
WHERE
    s.refresh_hash = $1
    AND s.revoked_at IS NULL
    AND s.expires_at > clock_timestamp()
FOR UPDATE OF s
FOR SHARE OF a
